description: This file implements text-to-speech conversion using external APIs (OpenAI and ElevenLabs), including stream processing with rate limiting, and provides functions to get available voices for each provider.

classes.name: TextToSpeechType
classes.description: Enumeration object for TTS provider types ('openai' and 'elevenlabs')

methods.name: convertTextToSpeechStream
methods.description: Converts text to speech stream using selected provider, handles stream processing, rate limiting, and abort signals.

methods.name: getVoices
methods.description: Retrieves available voices for specified TTS provider, either from predefined list (OpenAI) or via API (ElevenLabs).
